(“Melkior” or the “Company”) ... is pleased to announce that it has signed a Definitive Agreement to acquire 100% of the Beschefer East Project (“Beschefer East” or the “Project”)'.

company_name.justification: The acquiring company is identified as 'Melkior Resources Inc. (“Melkior” or the “Company”)' in the first paragraph of the press release.

ceo_buyer.justification: The text states: 'Jonathon Deluce, CEO of Melkior, stated, “We are excited to announce signing the Definitive Agreement with SOQUEM at the Beschefer East Project..."'.

interest_acquired_percent.justification: The text states Melkior has signed a 'Definitive Agreement to acquire 100% of the Beschefer East Project' and 'Melkior has the right to earn a 100% interest in the Project through an option'.

primary_commodity.justification: The project is described as having 'significant gold and polymetallic potential'. The text highlights nearby gold deposits and historical gold intercepts on the property, such as 'historical drilling has identified 55.63 g/t gold over 5.57 metres' on the adjacent project and '2.03 g/t Au over 6.1 metres' on Beschefer East itself.
